post.description:
Initiates workflow by workflow template ID. Allowed content types:
  • multipart/form-data (only way to submit files) in structure fieldName:fieldValue
  • application/x-www-form-urlencoded in structure fieldName=fieldValue
  • application/json in structure { "fieldName" : "fieldValue" }

parameters.name: templateId
parameters.description: ID of workflow template

parameters.name: title
parameters.description: Workflow Instance title

put.description:
Submit active workflow by Token ID. Allowed content types:
  • multipart/form-data (only way to submit files) in structure fieldName:fieldValue
  • application/x-www-form-urlencoded in structure fieldName=fieldValue
  • application/json in structure { "fieldName" : "fieldValue" }

parameters.name: tokenId
parameters.description: ID of workflow token

put.description:
Save the form without submitting the stage. Save workflow by resultSetId or workflowName. Allowed content types:
  • multipart/form-data (only way to submit files) in structure fieldName:fieldValue
  • application/x-www-form-urlencoded in structure fieldName=fieldValue
  • application/json in structure { "fieldName" : "fieldValue" }
